title: B: -11 §5 own-listing LeafNode check (PR #113)
description: mls-extensions-11 §5 L966-973: a LeafNode is invalid if its app_data_dictionary has an entry (other than app_components/safe_aad) not listed in its own app_components; applies wherever a LeafNode is validated, including KeyPackages. Add to check_leaf paths: Add KeyPackage leaves, Update, UpdatePath, check_tree on join, own leaf, KeyPackage verification.
